answer: Sybil resistance binds every agent to a TPM/SGX enclave; zero-knowledge attestation proves its unique key and measured model. The ripple state tree anchors keys, terrace is the consensus verifier for attestations and VDF proofs, and sonnet is the slashing circuit. Forgery requires provisioning distinct physical silicon or breaking enclave isolation; admission bonds impose an O(N^2) curve and irreversible slashing for duplicate identities.
